summary: Lolo NF crow's nest 1935 near Crystal Lake, abandoned 1941; FFLA says Abandoned, not Gone. No source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1941; no source says the structure was removed or describes what remains

corrections.why: The FFLA table gives this site's status as Abandoned, not Gone, and firelookout.com says it was abandoned in 1941. Neither source says the structure was removed.

notes_for_editor: Dates and elevation rest on the firelookout.com page alone. The record's kind 'platform' is correct under data/vocab.json, which includes crow's nests, so no kind correction. Location checks out roughly: the record point lies about 5.5 miles SSW of Haugan's town centre (Wikipedia, 47.38333 N, 115.39972 W), close to the page's 'six miles south of Haugan'. Do not confuse with the McGee Peak lookout in the Lassen National Forest, Shasta County, California (the Magee Peak weebly page and the 1930 Searchlight quotes there); that is a different site and was excluded. Mineral Peak near Missoula came up in search and is also a different site.
